response.description:
Support for Node.js 22 will end on April 30, 2027, please transition to Node.js 24 by that date. Your Azure Function apps will continue to run, but security patches and updates will no longer be provided and customer support for Node.js 22 will be discontinued. Running function apps on unsupported runtime or language version may lead to issues and degraded performance. Upgrade is required to maintain support eligibility.Required ActionTo avoid potential security vulnerabilities, minimize risk for your Azure Functions apps, and take advantage of latest features, follow the steps to upgrade your app to Node.js 24 before April 30, 2027.Learn
more.
response.title: Retirement: Support for Node.js 22 ends on April 30, 2027
